baseline_models.focus_anchor: The descent of the Book, its being given to earlier recipients, and the repeated response of belief.
baseline_models.mechanism: Purposeful delivery, a written object, and giving form a custody chain: the Book reaches an addressee, is already held by another recipient group, and elicits recognition across groups.

activation_trace.role: Caused delivery makes the Book something intentionally brought to its addressee.
The written object supplies the stable item repeated on both sides of the recipient relation.
Giving makes prior recipients trustees of what arrived rather than merely observers of it.

changed_reading.before: A Book is revealed and two sets of people happen to accept it.
changed_reading.after: The focus presents revelation as a delivered trust whose recognition can continue across distinct recipient groups.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of belief contrasted with denying Our signs and the final disbelievers.
baseline_models.mechanism: Visible marks invite heart-settled trust, while jahd supplies denial of what is inwardly known and kufr supplies an act of covering. The opposition is therefore asymmetric: faith settles into disclosed evidence, whereas rejection suppresses presence rather than reporting simple absence.

activation_trace.role: Security and trust make the repeated belief a settled entrustment, not only an opinion.
Heart-settled verification supplies the assent directed twice toward the Book.
Denial despite knowledge makes rejection willful concealment of recognized evidence.
A manifest sign supplies the disclosed marks that denial must act against.
Covering gives the final class its operative action: overlaying what the signs expose.

changed_reading.after: Belief is repose and trust in manifest marks; the opposed posture knowingly covers marks already available.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The Book is both sent down and repeated across the two recipient clauses under the analogical opening.
baseline_models.mechanism: Joining and binding branches of Book combine with descent as proper placement: revelation can be read as an assembled normative order placed into successive human locations, not merely as an inert document moved downward.

activation_trace.role: Placement in a fitting station activates the addressee as a deliberate human location for revelation.
Joining parts supplies an assembled corpus and links the repeated Book mentions structurally.
A fixed ruling gives the assembled Book normative force rather than only material form.

changed_reading.before: The Book is a textual object transferred to readers.
changed_reading.after: The Book is also an ordered, binding assembly deliberately placed among recipients whose response reveals alignment or resistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening distinguishes saying belief from belief that survives assay. Repetition of the focus root after this frame makes the two believing groups instances of disclosed, durable trust, while denial belongs to the exposed contrary posture.

activation_trace.role: The focus repetitions provide the assent whose durability is being re-read.
Professed assent supplies the initial claim that testing must distinguish from durable belief.
Assay of metal or persons makes pressure the mechanism that discloses the quality of belief.
The repeated assay extends that disclosure mechanism across earlier communities.
Truth realized in action supplies the durable outcome on one side of the assay.
Contradiction of truth supplies the exposed failure opposite enacted fidelity.

structural_cues: 29:2 puts saying belief before the negated expectation of being left untested.
29:3 sequences testing before the disclosure of truthful and false claimants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared faith vocabulary and an assay-to-disclosure sequence; I infer that this opening qualifies the focus believers as tested rather than merely self-declared. A live alternative is that the tests characterize persons generally without narrowing belief in this particular Book.

changed_reading.before: The focus records assent to the Book at one moment.
changed_reading.after: Its repeated belief is a trust whose truth becomes legible through pressure and enacted fidelity across communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier events are made into signs, and one destroyed locale leaves a clear sign behind for reasoning. Those recurrences broaden the focus plural from textual units alone to an archive in which rescued lives and surviving material traces become legible marks gathered by the Book.

activation_trace.role: The focus plural anchors every contextual event back to manifest marks being denied.
Knowing denial makes failure to read surviving evidence an active refusal.
Rescue by separation supplies an event whose outcome can persist as evidence.
The packet explicitly converts the rescue and ship sequence into a manifest sign.
An effect remaining after departure supplies the material persistence of a sign.
The residue is explicitly classified as a sign, joining material trace to the focus plural.
Disclosure and visibility make the residue evidential rather than merely leftover matter.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the operation needed to bind trace into judgment.

structural_cues: 29:15 predicates signhood of a rescue-and-ship event.
29:35 says a clear sign was left from a place and assigns its uptake to people who reason.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated predications of signhood and a surviving-effect branch; I infer that these occurrences widen the referential field of the focus plural and that the Book gathers them narratively. The live alternative is that the focus means only its own textual signs while prior event-signs remain analogies.

changed_reading.before: Our signs are verses or propositions inside the Book.
changed_reading.after: Our signs can also be rescued outcomes and durable historical residue that the Book makes readable, so denial refuses an evidential archive.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding imperative couples following-recitation of revealed Book with established prayer, then names prayer as a restraint on conduct. This activates the binding Book as a repeated practice that can enter behavior rather than remaining an acknowledged possession.

activation_trace.role: The focus Book carries the fixed normative force whose mode of operation is sharpened by the preceding imperative.
Following in sequence makes recitation an iterative accompaniment rather than passive ownership.
Divine communication identifies the recited material as received guidance rather than self-authored speech.
The same binding Book is the object to be followed in recitation.
Specified worship supplies the recurrent embodied setting paired with recitation.
Checking and restraining action supplies the behavioral effect of established worship.

structural_cues: 29:45 orders recitation of what was revealed from the Book and establishment of prayer in one imperative sequence.
The verse then predicates behavioral restraint of the established practice before 29:47 again names the Book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, shared Book vocabulary, iterative following, worship, and restraint; I infer a recitation-to-practice-to-restraint pathway. The live alternative is that prayer alone restrains while the recitation command remains coordinated but causally separate.

changed_reading.before: Belief in the Book is recognition of its truth or provenance.
changed_reading.after: Belief also admits the Book into a recurring recited practice whose binding order is capable of checking conduct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding address regulates engagement with People of the Book, confesses belief in what was sent to both sides, and aligns them under one deity and surrender. The focus analogical opening then reads as a hinge of reciprocal recognition, not merely a census of separate believer populations.

activation_trace.role: Joining supplies the focus Book as a potential connector across the repeated recipient positions.
Repeated assent anchors the contextual reciprocity back in the focus responses.
Entwined contention supplies the social friction that the prescribed mode of engagement regulates.
The written revelation identifies the addressed community by its relation to a Book.
Doing what is good supplies the constructive manner required for cross-group engagement.
The confession of assent initiates reciprocity before the focus reports assent in the other direction.
Parallel deliveries to us and to you establish revelation as shared provenance across addressees.
Divine oneness provides the common orientation without collapsing recipient plurality.
Yielding and handing oneself over supplies the shared posture beneath reciprocal confession.

structural_cues: 29:46 immediately precedes the focus and repeats Book, belief, and descent with explicit us-and-you deixis.
The focus opens with an analogical connector and then distributes belief across those given the Book and some among these.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, an analogical opening, parallel descent, and reciprocal pronouns; I infer that 29:47 carries the bridge from prescribed speech into recognized response. A live alternative is that the focus groups are only descriptive subsets and do not enact the reciprocal norm.

changed_reading.before: The verse states that members of two populations believe the newly delivered Book.
changed_reading.after: The verse becomes a hinge in a cross-scriptural ethic: confess the shared source without erasing difference, then recognize genuine assent across recipient communities.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus sequence denies prior textual manufacture, locates clear signs in the breasts of knowledge-recipients, and calls the descended Book sufficient as something recited to hearers, mercy, and reminder. The Book's operative presence therefore spans stable text, embodied custody, vocal circulation, and recollection.

activation_trace.role: The focus written object supplies the textual pole that context expands without canceling.
Manifest signs anchor the expanded modes of presence back to what the focus says is denied.
The doubled sign occurrence identifies what is both carried inwardly and denied outwardly.
Manifest disclosure marks the inwardly carried signs as clear rather than private obscurity.
The chest as an origin of action makes learned custody embodied and potentially productive.
Giving knowledge parallels the focus giving of the Book and shifts custody from object alone to recipient capacity.
Disclosure to the knower supplies the competence in which the clear signs reside.
Adequacy makes the recited Book sufficient for the communicative task at issue.
Successive following makes the Book present as continuing recitation to its hearers.
Tender mercy supplies a relational effect of the recited Book beyond information transfer.
A reminder that makes one remember supplies the Book's renewing action in recipients.

structural_cues: 29:48 negates prior recitation of a Book and handwriting by the addressee as the source of the focus revelation.
29:49-51 move from clear signs in the breasts of knowledge-recipients to a descended Book recited to hearers and declared sufficient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a contrast with authored handwriting, an inward location, repeated giving, recitation, sufficiency, mercy, and reminder; I infer a distributed mode of presence rather than a replacement of text by interiority. A live alternative confines breasts to memorized knowledge and treats sufficiency as unrelated to embodiment.

changed_reading.before: The Book is chiefly an external written artifact that groups either accept or reject.
changed_reading.after: The Book persists through text, knowledgeable breasts, voiced succession, and renewed memory; belief is participation in that living custody.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending directly reverses the focus sequence by pairing covering with what We gave them, then places sanctuary-security and belief under the same root while opposing belief in falsehood to covering divine benefit. Faith and kufr become directional allocations of trust and acknowledgment after reception, not mere presence or absence of cognition.

activation_trace.role: The focus gift establishes reception as the condition under which response is judged.
Trust and security supply the relational force of belief that the ending makes spatially vivid.
Concealing a benefit activates the final class as ungrateful recipients, not uninformed outsiders.
Covering a received benefit directly supplies the negative response to what was given.
The repeated We-gave-them construction mirrors the focus custody formula.
Consumable benefit supplies the diversion of a gift into temporary use rather than acknowledgment.
A protected precinct supplies the spatial container in which security is experienced.
The exact security root couples a safe sanctuary with the act of lodging trust in a target.
Rapid snatching outside the sanctuary makes the supplied security concrete and contrastive.
Beneficent condition identifies what the paired covering refuses to acknowledge.
Covering benefit completes the chiasm with belief directed toward falsehood.

structural_cues: 29:66 places cover and We gave them in the same construction, reversing the focus's We gave them the Book and they believe in it.
29:67 sets a secure sanctuary amid snatching beside believing in falsehood and covering divine benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct syntactic echoes and same-root security/belief; I infer that belief names where trust is lodged and kufr names concealment of a recognized gift. The live alternative keeps security and assent as separate lexical senses and reads the ending only as moral contrast.

changed_reading.before: Recipients either possess belief in the Book or lack it and become disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Every recipient allocates trust somewhere: fidelity lodges security in the delivered truth, while kufr redirects trust and covers the gift already received.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads a spatial reversal across different roots rather than claiming a formal derivation. It remains valid because the focus covering branch is attached to the same disbelieving class later encircled and overlaid. Downstream prose should present it as an exploratory image, not as certain wordplay or lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The covering branch of the final disbelievers who deny manifest signs.

activation_trace.role: Active covering supplies the outward operation performed against the focus signs.
Overwhelming enclosure turns the coverers into the surrounded object.
The enclosed group is identified by the same covering root as the focus final class.
A covering that spreads over all completes the reversal from covering signs to being covered from above.

changed_reading.before: Disbelievers are agents who cover the signs.
changed_reading.after: The surah briefly mirrors their action spatially: those who cover disclosed signs become the enclosed and over-covered object.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the watercourse branch of the focus giving root against its ordinary giving sense. It remains anchored in the focus pairing of descent, Book, and recipients and in the later descending water that revives. Downstream prose must qualify the conduit model as a material heuristic, not a translation or a claim that every recipient transmits.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: We sent down the Book to you and gave the Book to them.

activation_trace.role: Caused descent supplies revelation's movement toward a receiving location.
A directed watercourse activates recipients as possible channels rather than terminal owners.
Joining allows the Book to hold together material delivered across more than one recipient group.
The later caused descent supplies the explicit water analogue for revelation's arrival.
Water delivered by pouring supplies the material flow through a receiving medium.
Rain-revived earth supplies the life-bearing effect tentatively mapped onto receptive circulation of the Book.

changed_reading.before: The Book terminates as a possession in each recipient group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the descended Book behaves like channeled provision: receptive communities can become conduits through which its joined signs reach and revive further hearers.

strongest_changes: The opening assay frame turns repeated belief from verbal assent into pressure-disclosed fidelity.
The immediate 29:46 bridge makes the focus a reciprocal recognition scene across revelation recipients.
The 29:49-51 sequence distributes the Book across text, knowledgeable breasts, recitation, mercy, and reminder.
The 29:66-67 echo recasts belief and kufr as rival allocations of trust and acknowledgment after a gift is received.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet supplied unusually direct same-root echoes on both sides of the focus: event-signs become surviving residue, Book becomes enacted and embodied, shared descent frames cross-group recognition, and the late pairing of security with belief and gift with covering reverses the focus grammar.
remaining_uncertainties: The precise referents of those given the Book and these remain underdetermined by the focus grammar.
The focus signs may be restricted to textual signs even though the surah repeatedly calls events, creation, and residue signs.
The security-to-belief and watercourse models are functional root activations, not secure lexical glosses.
The causal share of recitation versus established prayer in behavioral restraint remains open.
